trim_rationale: Conservative common preprocessing for QuantSeq FWD: remove initial random-primer bases, Illumina adapter, poly-A and two-colour NextSeq poly-G tails, low-quality 3prime bases; differs from author Trimmomatic and is not claimed exact reproduction
qc_hold_action: Retain all samples; pause formal disease inference if any threshold fails. Investigate technical cause, preserve results and record separate amendment before any change.
expression_filter: Entrez gene CPM >=1 in at least7 of14 samples using raw library size, before TMM; label independent
entrez_mapping: GENCODE v47 transcript Entrez map joined through same GTF; retain genes with exactly one distinct Entrez ID and sum counts for multiple stable gene IDs sharing same Entrez; no symbol rescue
primary_endpoint: Unchanged original100UP/90DOWN mean within-sample percentile rank difference on filtered Entrez genes shared with discovery; exact one-sided unadjusted label permutations C(14,7)=3432
primary_family: GSE237861 plus original GSE141864 FFPE result, BH family2
sensitivity: Sex-stratified exact permutations C(10,6)*C(4,1)=840 using group coefficient in score~sex+group; original50/50; leave-one-patient-out score direction
secondary_model: edgeR quasi-likelihood GLM ~sex+group using TMM-normalized gene counts; all-gene BH; age descriptive only due small n
pathway_model: limma voom camera ~sex+group using estimated residual correlation primary, fixed0.01 sensitivity; planned two-cohort five-pathway family
eligibility: No disease inference before all14 publisher FASTQ checksums, reference hashes, runtime and count QC pass; primary query coverage>=0.70 each direction
interpretation: Terminal sepsis vs noninfectious critically ill autopsy heart. No echo-based SCM case definition and no drug efficacy inference. Post-screen external disease assessment.
